name: kwtsms-mcp
description: Send SMS through kwtSMS (Kuwait): balance, Sender IDs, coverage. Preview and test mode by default.
long_description: Lets your AI assistant send SMS through the kwtSMS gateway, check your balance, Sender IDs and coverage, validate numbers and read message status. Safe by default: preview and test sends only until you allow live sending, with per-call, hourly and daily limits and a fixed Sender ID.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Preview, test or live SMS send

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Countries the account can send to

username.title: kwtSMS API username
username.description: API username from your kwtSMS account (not your mobile number)

sender_id.title: Sender ID
sender_id.description: Used for every send. KWT-SMS is for testing only.

allow_live.title: Allow live sending
allow_live.description: Off: preview and test sends only. On: real SMS after you confirm each one.
